title: In the aircraft about 200 meters from a class 8 object, nobody sees it

place_text: Airborne near the El Paso area

tellings.quote: And I know they don't They see, because I was, probably 200 meters away from an 8th class object,

plain: James Valor, a witness connected with Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call up unexplained flying objects, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a flight near El Paso, Texas, in 2025. He says he was about 200 meters from what he calls an "8th class" object, a category in the team's own way of ranking what they see, and yet the people around him in the aircraft did not see it. If true, it would mean some of these objects can be right beside people without being noticed.
